title: Trail closures until further notice due to extreme high water and flooding
description: Due to flooding, the following trails are closed until further notice: Wire Road and Gibson Mill Trail. The low-water crossing on the Manley Uplands Trail is also closed until further notice.

title: Broken Windsock at Serpentine Hot Springs
description: The windsock at the Serpentine Hot Springs airstrip is broken, and the National Park Service is in the process of ordering a replacement. At this time, we do not have an estimated date for when it will be reinstalled. Please use caution when utilizing the airstrip.

title: Temporary Swimming & Fishing Closure at Nemo and Rock Creek
description: The waters around Rock Creek Campground and Nemo Day Use Area within the jurisdictional boundaries of Obed WSR are temporarily closed to swimming and fishing, due to a railroad derailment that occurred June 11, 2026. This closure will be lifted when the damage has been assessed, and cleanup work has been completed.

title: Temporary Closure of Nemo Day Use Area and Rock Creek Campround
description: Obed WSR has temporarily closed Rock Creek Campground as well as Nemo Day Use Area for visitor safety due to a railroad derailment that occurred June 11, 2026. This closure will be lifted when the damage has been assessed, and cleanup work has been completed.

title: Road Closures - Cascade River Road
description: Cascade River Road is closed to vehicles at milepost 20 (Eldorado) two miles before the trailhead. There are additional road closures due to construction on Cascade River Road in June. Visit the Road Conditions page for more information on road closures within the park complex.

title: Box Fire in Rincon Mountains (east district)
description: The Box Fire is currently burning in the Rincon Mountains west of Juniper Basin Campground. The Tanque Verde Ridge Trail, Loma Alta Trailhead, and X9 Ranch access routes are closed while firefighting operations are ongoing. Juniper Basin and Grass Shack backcountry campgrounds are also closed.

title: Pavement Preservation Project at LBJ Ranch June 15-20
description: From June 15 though June 20 a pavement preservation crew will begin repaving parking areas and sections of the road on the LBJ Ranch. The LBJ Ranch will remain open each day from 9am until 5pm. Visitors should expect temporary traffic control, construction equipment, periodic noise, and minor delays near active work areas.

title: Park Loop Road Detour
description: A section of the Park Loop Road, from Kebo Street to Sieur de Monts, will be closed to all uses from April 13 to late June, excluding Memorial Day Weekend. A detour will redirect motorists out to Mount Desert Street and Main Street following Route 3 to re-enter the Park Loop Road at Sieur de Monts.

title: Prescribed Burn
description: A prescribed burn was conducted in the park uplands 6/11-6/12. Smoke and some burning logs may still be seen.

title: Heat Warning
description: Due to the lack of air conditioning in park buildings, visitors are cautioned to limit their time inside the main laboratory building and be aware of signs of heat exhaustion.

title: Glenmont Heat Advisory
description: The house at Glenmont is currently experiencing high heat conditions. As a result, house tours may be abbreviated or canceled due to safety concerns.

title: Hemlock Creek Segment — Logging Activities
description: Logging operations along the Hemlock Creek Segment may mean heavy machinery and trucks in the area. The Ice Age Trail follows a logging road used for storage and transport of logs. The Trail is open. Stay alert. Remain on the trail. Use caution. Keep dogs leashed.

title: Tisch Mills Segment — Seasonal Flooding
description: The Ice Age Trail from Mill Road to Nuclear Road is often flooded in spring or after heavy rain. To bypass this section, follow CTH-B between CTH-BB and Nuclear Road.

title: Summit Moraine Segment — Timber Harvest Nearby
description: A timber harvest is taking place east of STH‑45 for approximately one mile in the vicinity of the Trail. The Ice Age Trail remains open, but heavy machinery may be operating in the area. Stay alert. Remain on the trail. Use caution. Keep dogs leashed.

title: Averill–Kelly Creek Wilderness Segment — Dangerous Ford at New Wood River
description: The New Wood River may be too high to safely ford. To bypass this section from the west, follow CTH‑E north for 1.9 miles, then continue east for 3.0 miles. At Burma Road, head south for 1.0 mile to rejoin the Ice Age Trail. Stay alert. Use caution. Keep dogs leashed.

title: Hot Conditions
description: Limit strenuous hiking to early morning and late evening hours. Expect temperatures in the High Peaks and Chalone Peak to be at least 10 degrees hotter than parking areas. Drink plenty of water and carry at least one liter of water for each hour of hiking. Bring salty snacks, a hat, and sunscreen for the hike. Know the signs and symptoms of heat related illnesses. In case of a heat related emergency get to a cool place and seek help immediately.

title: Castle Williams & Fort Jay Re-opening
description: Both Castle Williams and Fort Jay are now open. The hours are Wednesday thru Sunday, 10AM to 4PM. If you have any questions, you can reach us through the contact link on this site.

title: Intermittent Road Work
description: Visitors should be aware that there is road work occurring in the park starting June 18th and potentially continuing throughout the month. There may be some minor delays and alternative parking arrangements.

title: Vehicle Break-Ins
description: Vehicle break-ins have occurred at the King Canyon Trailhead, as well as at other trailheads throughout the park. Hide valuables and consider taking them with you, secure your vehicle, and report any suspicious activity. Please call 911 to report criminal activity or the Pima County Sherriff's Department Non-Emergency number at 520-351-4900.

title: Hurricane Hill Road Closed Mon-Thurs Through July 2
description: Due to a water system rehabilitation project, Hurricane Hill Road will be closed Monday-Thursday through July 2. The road will reopen every Friday-Sunday as long as all vehicles continue to clear the area by Sunday evening and do not impede construction activities on Monday morning. Hurricane Ridge Road will remain open throughout the construction period. See the Hurricane Ridge section on the Alerts and Conditions page for more information.

title: Tree Hazard Along Charles Pinckney Nature Trail
description: A tree is partially downed along the Charles Pinckney nature trail, about 150-feet from the accessible trail. All trails remain open; cones will be used to mark the hazard.

title: Reds Meadow Road Access Restrictions in 2026
description: Reds Meadow Road remains under construction in 2026 and will be closed Monday through Friday from June 13 through July 1, then Monday through Wednesday from July 2 through September 20, then Monday through Friday starting September 21.

title: Memorial Bridge Closed Friday, June 12, 2026, from 6:00 pm to 11:59 pm
description: Memorial Bridge closed Friday, June 12, 2026, from 6:00 pm to 11:59 pm. for events at the Lincoln Memorial.

title: Lower Lehman Campground Closed 6/14 (12pm) through 6/18
description: The Lower Lehman Campground will be closed starting 6/14 at 12pm through 6/18 for roadway maintenance. All campers must vacate the campground by 12pm PST on 6/14.

title: Harmful Algae Bloom
description: A Harmful Algae Bloom has been confirmed in recent water samples taken from the Nelson's Landing and the Cottonwood Cove areas on Lake Mohave. To reduce health risks, the National Park Service recommends recreators limit body contact with these waters when algae is present. Please click here for pictures of this dangerous cyanobacteria and contact the Park at 702-293-8990 for updates on this advisory.

title: East Rim Drive is currently CLOSED from Skellhead to Park Headquarters
description: East Rim Drive is currently CLOSED from Skellhead to Park Headquarters. The non-construction section (Skellhead to Phantom Ship Overlook) will not reopen until late June or early July 2026. West Rim Drive, North Entrance Road, and East Rim Drive from North Junction to Skellhead are now OPEN for travel. (The map to the right is inaccurate due to technical difficulties.)

title: Visitor Center Parking Lot Paving and Repair - Late June and Early July
description: Repaving and repair of the visitor center parking lot will take place in late June and early July, weather permitting. Visitors traveling to the park during this time can expect impacts and delays. Tentative dates are June 22 - July 3 - check back for updates.

title: Point Campground Closure
description: The Point Campground will be closed from June 15 - 25, 2026 for road repaving and construction. Reservations cannot be made during this time.

title: Being Prepared for Excessive Heat & Humidity
description: Congaree can be hot & humid from late spring through early fall. Be sure that you & your party (including pets) have adequate water & choose activities that fit your level of physical fitness. Consider visiting early in the morning when it is cooler.

title: Natural Entrance Trail Closed
description: Due to bird guano cleaning, the Natural Entrance trail will be closed starting Wednesday, June 17 and will reopen on Thursday, June 18th. During this time the cave will be accessible only by elevators. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

title: Road work at El Malpais Visitor Center
description: Repaving of the El Malpais Visitor Center parking lot will occur in June. The visitor center will remain open, but slight delays are possible. Please follow construction signage and directions.

title: Fire restrictions in place
description: Fire restrictions are in place at Mojave National Preserve and Castle Mountains National Monument. Wood and charcoal fires are not permitted. Most camp stoves are. See fire restriction order for additional details.

title: Fire restrictions in place
description: Fire restrictions are in place at Mojave National Preserve and Castle Mountains National Monument. Wood and charcoal fires are not permitted. Most camp stoves are. See fire restriction order for additional details.

title: Route 252 Closed between Route 23 and Covered Bridge - June 15 to June 26
description: PennDOT Drainage Crew will replace eight drainage pipes along Route 252 between Route 23 and the Knox Covered Bridge on Yellow Springs Road. Work is scheduled to begin on Monday June 15 and is expected to be completed by Friday June 26, 2026. Daytime road closures will be in effect throughout the project. All traffic will be detoured during working hours. Motorists are encouraged to plan ahead, allow additional travel time, and follow posted detour routes.

title: Wind Cave Canyon Trail Closed for Repair and Improvement
description: Wind Cave Canyon Trail is closed so that the trail and adjoining road can be repaired from frequent washouts. Sixteen low water crossings will be hardened and the road resurfaced. The trail could be closed for several weeks.

title: Closure of Santa Rosa Island Due to Wildfire
description: Santa Rosa Island is closed to all day and overnight use through at least June 30, 2026, due to a recent wildfire. Click the more link for additional information.

title: I-70 Closure in Downtown Topeka May Affect Travel to the Park
description: I-70 is closed through downtown Topeka between Topeka Boulevard and 8th Avenue due to construction. Visitors traveling to Brown v. Board of Education National Historical Park should allow extra travel time and follow posted detours. Westbound visitors may continue on I-70 and follow signs to local exits near downtown Topeka. Eastbound visitors should use I-470 around Topeka, then connect to local streets to reach the park at 1515 SE Monroe Street. Check KanDrive.gov or call 511 for current road condition

title: Current Park Closures
description: Closures may occur due to inclement weather, construction projects, or other emergency conditions. Please visit the linked page for information about current closures.

title: Historic Lantern Tours to Pause Due to Construction
description: There will be a pause in Historic Lantern Tours beginning June 16th due to a construction project on the trail leading to the tour route. Scenic, Discovery and Wild Caving Tours will not be impacted and will still be offered. Once the project is completed, Historic Lantern Tours will resume and be reopened for booking.

title: Western Gulls Nesting on Anacapa Island From April Through Mid-August
description: During this time, visitors will encounter seabird rookery conditions: guano, strong odor, constant noise, bird carcasses, and birds protecting their territory. If visitors consider these conditions adverse, it is advised that they visit another island.

title: NPS 300 Road Conditions
description: NPS 300 to Big Tubes is dry with some rutted areas. Road conditions may change after thunderstorms. A four-wheel-drive vehicle is recommended.

title: Current East Rim Trail Status: Open
description: As of Thursday, June 4, 2026 the East Rim Trail System remains open. For more information, visit the website linked below. In good conditions the mountain bike trails are open 6 am-11 pm for bikers and as posted for other trail users. In wet or hazardous conditions, the trail will close to all users to prevent damage. Be flexible; conditions may change throughout the day.

title: EV charging station unavailable
description: The Electric Vehicle charging station is non-functional. There is no timeline for when it may become available. Please plan accordingly.

title: Temporary Wall Street Closures
description: Beginning Monday June 15, the Wall Street side of the Navajo Loop will be closed Monday - Thursday from 6 AM to 12 Noon for critical trail stabilization work. The Two Bridges side of the Navajo Loop will remain open. This work will continue through the 2026 season.

title: Control Tower Closed
description: The Control Tower is closed due to a restoration project. The project is expected to be completed in July 2026.

title: Expect Delays: Park-wide Road Striping
description: Road striping is underway from south to north on major and minor park roads, turnouts, and lots. Expect slow traffic, pilot cars, and delays up to 15 minutes. Drive with caution and do not cross wet paint lines. Work is highly weather-dependent. Plan for extra travel time.

title: Old Springs Trail near Tennessee Valley Closed until August 2026
description: The trail will be closed for boardwalk replacement and general maintenance until early August. Surrounding trails will remain open to provide an alternative route. Please pay attention to safety signage and stay out of the closed area.

title: OSV Status
description: 6/8/26 MD open to State Line. VA South OSV fully closed. The VA North OSV fishing mile is open to 12 vehicles.

title: Fire Restrictions in Place
description: Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are in effect. Wood and charcoal fires are prohibited at all low-elevation campgrounds and picnic areas. Additional restrictions apply. Click "more" for details.

title: Avoid Ticks on Site!
description: Ticks are very active at New Philadelphia. Use insect repellant and stay on trails. Avoid brushing against logs, shrubs, and grasses. Check your body for ticks after your visit. Learn more about keeping safe from ticks on the Safety page.

title: Hours Changing
description: The Visitor Center at Friendship Hill National Historic Site is now open seven days a week from 9 AM to 5 PM! The grounds and trails remain open sunrise to sunset. If you have any questions, please give us a call at 724-329-2501 or visit our website at www.nps.gov/frhi

title: Photo Season
description: Just a reminder as the weather is starting to get nice, and people are thinking about where to take graduation, wedding, prom or formal, pregnancy, birthday, and any other type of photography or filming! We do have rules and regulations on what is or is not allowed and whether or not you need a permit. Violations may be ticketed. Please check our website under Plan Your Visit, Permits and Reservations!!! https://www.nps.gov/frhi/planyourvisit/permits.htm

title: Visitor Center Temporarily Closed due to High Temperatures
description: The visitor center is temporarily closed due to high interior temperatures. Upon arrival proceed directly to the Saxton House. The Saxton House will be open to all visitors during normal hours, and guided tours will be temporarily replaced by ranger talks.

title: Large vehicle restrictions now in effect for Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway
description: As of June 7, 2026, the park is enforcing size and weight limits for vehicles on the Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway. Vehicles that exceed length, width, height, or weight limits cannot travel between Canyon Junction and the park's East Entrance. See the current limits on the page linked below.

title: Bumpass Hell Trail Closed
description: The Bumpass Hell Trail is under a seasonal closure due to accumulated winter snow. This is an annual closure to prevent injury from treacherous trail conditions. The trail typically remains closed through mid-July. Learn more

title: Road work with possible delays and closures 06/08-12 2026
description: Schedule subject to change. Chipseal work on Volcano Road scheduled Monday June 08th, through Friday the 12th 2026. Crews will have flaggers and pilot cars for travel up and down Volcano Road. There may be delays and closures depending on work being performed. We are sorry for any inconvenience.

title: Lindenwald Opens for 2026 Season
description: Lindenwald Tours – 2026 Season Lindenwald is open for tours Friday–Sunday at 10 AM, 11 AM, 1 PM, and 3 PM. Tours are first-come, first-served. Monday–Thursday: grounds are open, but no tours are available. Park stamps, and restrooms are available in the Visitor Center.

title: Heat Notice
description: Adams NHP is experiencing an elevated heat index which may result in tours and access to the historic homes being modified or cancelled. Please be aware that indoor temperatures may exceed outdoor temperatures. Please call 617-770-1175 for information.

title: Lassen National Park Highway Open for the 2026 Season
description: The Lassen National Park Highway (Hwy. 89, 30 miles through the park) opened to through traffic on May 22, 2026. Google maps and other third-party sites may be indicating the road is closed. This does not reflect accurate information.

title: Limited Rialto Beach Parking, Mora Rd Construction & Closure Begins July 8
description: Contractors have begun staging equipment and materials for Mora Road repairs in the Quileute Tribe's parking lot. Parking in the NPS lot at Rialto Beach is very limited. Consider carpooling or visiting other beaches. Beginning July 8th, Mora Road will close to all traffic, including bicycles and pedestrians, at the campground. Rialto Beach will not be accessible via Mora Road during this construction period. Mora Campground will remain open.

title: Beach closure in place in front of Buxton Village
description: The entire beachfront in front of Buxton Village is temporarily closed to public entry due to the presence of threatened oceanfront structures.

title: Kahuku Unit Roads
description: Kahuku Road beyond the cross fence (mile marker 4) is closed to vehicles; pedestrian use is permitted. Four-wheel drive is strongly recommended past the Upper Palm Trailhead (mile marker 3).

title: Special Hours - Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park
description: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park - Seattle Unit's visitor center and museum will be open on Mondays and Tuesdays starting on June 15, 2026 through July 7, 2026.

title: 2:00 PM Tour Will Not Be Available – July 10, 2026
description: The 2:00 PM guided tour on Friday July 10, 2026, will not be available. Visitors are welcome to explore the park using the self-guided “Mill Mile” tour—click “More” for information.

title: July 1-4 Street Closures & Parking Info During City of Paterson Program
description: McBride Ave. Ext. and Spruce St. will be closed but the park is open and park tours still available. Due to the street closures, the Overlook Park parking lot at 72 McBride Avenue Extension will be inaccessible. Limited parking within walking distance may be found at the Paterson Museum and the lot across from the Museum.

title: Parking Lot E Closed for Construction
description: Parking Lot E is closed for construction. The park is currently working to expand this parking area, and the lot will be closed while the expansion is being built. Visitors can still access the Mary Byrd Branch Trail and Quantico Cascades Trail by following trail reroute signs and parking vehicles in Turkey Run parking area. For your safety, please follow all closures and only park in designated parking spots.

title: Expect delays due to paving on Potash Road/SR-279
description: Paving crews will be working weekdays from 7 am to 7 pm from June 8 through mid-July. Expect closures along the road shoulders in active work zones, and short delays with alternating one-way traffic controlled by a flagging operation.

title: Road workers on Park Road in Davis Bayou
description: Phase II of the Davis Bayou Bicycle and Pedestrian Path is in process. Visitors may encounter minor traffic delays and flaggers on Eagle Point and Park Road.

title: Park Headquarters Road closed
description: Park Headquarters Road is closed due to rehabilitation work on the Sugarlands water and wastewater systems.

title: Potable Water Unavailable at the Au Sable Light Station
description: Drinking water is currently unavailable at the Au Sable Light Station.

title: Fredericksburg Battlefield Visitor Center Closed, Store and Grounds Open
description: Starting November 20, 2025 the Fredericksburg Battlefield Visitor Center will be closed while updates are made to building systems. Front Desk operations including visitor orientation will move to the adjacent Fredericksburg Battlefield Bookstore. The Chancellorsville Visitor Center remains open to visitors 9am - 5pm all week.

title: Valley Road Closure
description: All 22 miles of the Valley Road is closed for construction until further notice. This is the only access road to the Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes

title: Ford's Theatre closed for Facility Upgrades June 3 - August 31, 2026
description: Ford's Theater and the Museum will temporarily close to public access on June 3, 2026, beginning at 9:00 a.m. The Theater will remain closed until July 31, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. The museum will remain closed until August 15, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. The Petersen House, the Center of Experiential Learning, and the Atlantic Lobby will remain open to the public. National Park Service staff will be available at these locations to provide site tours and visitor information.

title: Barataria Visitor Center and Trails are Closed
description: Because of upcoming demolition and construction of the trails and Visitor Center, all trails at the Barataria Preserve and the Visitor Center are closed, with the exception of Twin Canals Trail. This is a day-use area only with no restrooms. Please join us Wednesdays and Thursdays 10:00 am - 2:00 pm for programming and a ranger talk at the town of Jean Lafitte Civic Center at at 1:00 pm at 4917 City Park Drive, Jean Lafitte, 70067.

title: Experiencing High Temperatures in the Visitor Center
description: While planning your visit to the site please note that we are currently experiencing some high temperatures in the Visitor Center. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause as we work to alleviate the issue.

title: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
description: There currently is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park.  Water is available at the RV Fill and Dump Station, the Great Basin, and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center as well as some local businesses.

title: Melting snow bridges and high streamflows create hazards for hikers, skiers, and snowshoers.
description: Be aware of hidden- and potentially fatal- hazards created by snow bridges and high streamflows on Mount Rainier.

title: Your GPS May Be Wrong
description: There are five entrances to the park. GPS may take you to the wrong entrance or attempt to follow the most direct route, which could lead to closed gates. It can take hours to reroute to the correct entrance. Check directions & maps, not just your GPS.

title: Cave Tour Reservations
description: Advance cave tour reservations up until July 31st are available. August reservations will become available on July 1st. Reservations are strongly recommended. Reservations full? Choose a day to come to the park early in the day to purchase a same day cave tour ticket.

title: Elk with Calves are Extremely Dangerous
description: Be alert, especially this time of year around Mammoth Hot Springs. Elk calves may be hidden close to buildings, under or next to vehicles, and around blind corners. You must remain at least 25 yards from all wildlife. If an elk charges, retreat!

title: Status of Trail Ridge Road
description: Trail Ridge Road (U.S. Hwy 34 inside Rocky Mountain National Park) is open to through travel. Timed Entry Reservations are required for Trail Ridge Road from 9 am to 2 pm. Updates are available on the recorded Trail Ridge Road Status Line at 970-586-1222. Updates are also available on the RMNP webpage and the official RMNP social media pages.

title: Expect long lines at entrances on weekends.
description: Lengthy delays are likely at the southwest park entrance on SR706 on weekends. Check Google Maps for backup (represented by the orange/red line) at link below. Please do not block driveways or roads while in line outside the park.

title: Kaymoor Miners Trail Closure
description: From June 15 through November 19 the upper part of the Kaymoor Miners Trail (from Kaymoor Top down to the mine site at the junction with the Kaymoor Trail) will be closed Monday through Thursday due to a trail rehab project. The trail is expected to be fully open Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

title: Heavy Traffic and High Visitation Alert
description: Pinnacles experiences extremely high visitation on weekends, holidays, and during favorable weather, especially in the spring. Expect long lines and delays between 10:00 am and 3:00 pm. If you're planning to hike the High Peaks, Condor Gulch, Balconies, or Moses Spring Trail, it’s recommended to arrive before 8:00 am (parking may fill earlier). Additionally, campground access may be temporarily delayed during peak periods of visitation when ALL incoming traffic is held.

title: Areas of Meridian Hill Park closed for repairs
description: Much of the upper level of the park is closed to rehabilitate the grass. Fountains and the reflecting pool are open but may be turned off or drained occasionally while adjustments to the water levels and further improvements occur. We expect the reflecting pool to be drained during the week of June 8 for additional work. Visit the Meridian Hill Park page for more information.

title: A Few Small Roads Closed Due to Roadway Damage and/or Repair Work
description: These roads are closed due to roadway damage during past storm events and/or repairs to roadway damage: Middle Fork Rd, South Fork Rd

title: Accessing Fort Barrancas
description: Fort Barrancas is open 9 am–4 pm Wednesday through Sunday. To access Fort Barrancas, visitors will need to enter the Naval Air station Pensacola through the west gate.

title: Phones down at Kingsley Plantation
description: As of 05/27, the phone lines are down at Kingsley Plantation. Please call the Fort Caroline Visitor Center at (904) 641-7155.

title: For entrance fees, we accept digital passes and credit/debit cards
description: Digital passes or credit/debit cards are the ONLY method of payment at all fee collection areas. Pre-paid digital passes are available online and may be purchased in advance.

title: Roadwork may cause delays on US 41/Tamiami Trail
description: Current roadwork is ongoing along the park's northern boundary on US Highway 41/Tamiami Trail to raise the road for Everglades Restoration benefits. Drivers may experience up to 15-minute delays and should watch for personnel, equipment and slow downs.

title: Everglades' Current Alerts and Conditions
description: Be sure to review the Alerts and Conditions page before and during your visit for additional, up-to-date information on closures, cautions, and other current park conditions.

title: Temporary Traffic Control and Detour for Bunker Road on June 15 7AM to 6PM
description: Contractor will be replacing culvert on Bunker Road near Capehart Housing Area on June 15 from 7AM to 6PM. Allow time for traffic control. Visitors entering the park should expect delays. Visitors exiting park will be routed over Conzelman Road. Please obey traffic controls.

title: Group Reservations
description: Groups of 11 or more people should contact the Visitor Center at ADAM_Visitor_Center@nps.gov or 617-770-1175 at least two weeks in advance to arrange their visit.

title: Great Hall, Faneuil Hall Closures: June 2026
description: Due to scheduled events, the Great Hall will be closed on June 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, and 13. The Great Hall will close at 2 pm on June 24 and 25. The Visitor Center Desk on the market floor will remain open.

title: Jacob Riis Park Access Restrictions
description: Due to extremely hazardous conditions Gateway National Recreation Area has restricted access to sections of Jacob Riis Park. Erosion has created unsafe conditions from Bays 1-5, and portions of the eastern beach are closed.

title: North Beach Tip at Sandy Hook closed
description: North Beach Tip at Sandy Hook is closed to access until further notice due to nesting bird activity.

title: Do Not Handle Wildlife
description: If you see a dead bat or a bat acting strangely at the fort, please do not touch or move it. Report the location of the animal to park staff.

title: Annual Summer Closures and Restrictions in Effect
description: The 49 Palms trail along with some campgrounds, facilities, and areas have adjusted availability during the summer. For the full list of changes, please visit our Summer Closures page.

title: Intermittent Road Closures June 2nd - June 4th
description: Maintenance work on the monument entrance road will take place Tuesday, June 2 through Thursday, June 4. During this period, visitors should expect intermittent road closures and single‑lane traffic. Please plan for delays when entering the monument.

title: Water Unavailable at Hensley Settlement
description: Water is temporarily unavailable at Hensley Settlement.

title: South parking lot closed to vehicles through June 30, 2026
description: The south parking lot of Greenbelt Park will be closed to vehicle access until June 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The area will remain available to pedestrians.

title: Perimeter Trail closed through June 30, 2026
description: The section of the perimeter trail from the 0.8 mile marker to the 1.9 mile marker at Park Central Road will remain closed until June 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m.

title: Upper and Lower Plaza Rehabilitation
description: The Plazas, Rotunda, and the Observation Deck of the Memorial will be inaccessible for the 2026 and 2027 seasons due to the Upper and Lower Plaza Rehabilitation. The visitor center and grounds will remain open. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Passenger Ferry Dock Closed; Visitors Deboard via Beach Landing
description: The ferry dock servicing the Cape Lookout Lighthouse area is closed for repairs. Visitors will deboard the ferry in front of the lighthouse. To reach the boardwalk, visitors will need to walk 5–10 minutes on soft sand. Depending on the tide, visitors may also need to walk through water.

title: Summer Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
description: From Memorial Day through Labor Day, the Birthplace will be open from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The tour schedule remains the same.

title: Lake Powell Recreational Water Advisory
description: Any time that you do recreational activities (swimming, water skiing, making sand castles, etc.) on the beaches or in the waters of Lake Powell you are strongly encouraged to follow basic hygiene practices. A number of conditions can cause potential water quality issues on Lake Powell, at Lees Ferry, and on Colorado River tributaries.

title: Seasonal Closure: Bush Key
description: Visitor access to Bush Key is suspended until Fall 2026 to protect nesting Sooty Terns, Brown Noddies, and Magnificent Frigatebirds. Boaters must maintain a distance of 100 feet from the island's mean low tide.

title: Closures: Detours; Towpath; Points of Interest
description: Multiple items are closed due to hazardous conditions or maintenance. See below for more details.

title: Cades Cove Loop Road is closed to motor vehicles every Wednesday
description: Cades Cove Loop Road is closed to motor vehicles every Wednesday through September 30. This allows pedestrians and cyclists to enjoy the cove without the presence of vehicles on the roadway.

title: Road Construction
description: Far View Sites and Cedar Tree Tower are closed for road improvements. Road work along the first four miles of the park road from the entrance station will begin in early summer. Delays of up to 30 minutes are possible - please check the park map before your visit. Wetherill Mesa Road has compacted gravel for 30 feet; motorcycles should take extra caution on this road.

title: Stage 2 Burn Restrictions
description: All campfires are prohibited. All outdoor fires, including, but not limited to, trash fires, charcoal fires, portable stoves, lanterns using gas, jellied petroleum, pressurized liquid fuel or fully enclosed (sheepherder type) stove and open fire branding activities are prohibited. Smoking shall be restricted to inside vehicles.

title: Update on Transponders
description: Due to some unexpected technical issues that are impacting recent transponder sales and renewals, Rocky Mountain National Park is temporarily pausing the sale and renewal of transponder devices. Updates will be posted on the park webpage.

title: Temporary hours of operation at Park Visitor Center due to Typhoon Sinlaku
description: The American Memorial Park Visitor Center is currently open Monday-Friday from 9-4 due to Typhoon Sinlaku recovery efforts. Park grounds and walking paths are accessible but visitors should use caution as there are fallen trees, stumps, and other typhoon debris.

title: Trail Closure at Scott’s Run Nature Preserve (McLean, Virginia)
description: Scott’s Run Nature Preserve in McLean, Virginia will close, beginning February 16th, for an urgent sewer project to renew and rehabilitate the Scott's Run Siphon wastewater facility. All trails and parking lots in the park are closed through July 4, 2026.

title: Trail Closure at Veterans Park at Balls Bluff (Leesburg, Virginia)
description: Veterans Park in Leesburg, Virginia, is closed for park improvements. All trails in the park are closed into late summer 2026.

title: Be Bear Aware
description: The park is bear habitat. There have been recent sightings of a bear near park trails and visitor areas. Never approach or offer food to a bear. Maintain a distance of at least 150 ft. If a bear approaches you, do not run or make any sudden movements. Make yourself look big; loudly and calmly tell the bear to "go away;" and slowly back away from the bear. Report any sightings to the nearest park ranger.

title: Major road construction on Hwy 199
description: Travelers using Highway 199 between Crescent City and Cave Junction should expect multiple traffic delays beginning as early as May due to ongoing Caltrans construction. For the most current delay and closure information—including upcoming four‑hour full closures—please check the Caltrans District 1 Road Information Bulletin for updates and follow their social media channels.

title: Bag Policy
description: Bags larger than 9"x11"x5" are not permitted in the historic homes. The park does not have storage lockers for these items. Bags may not be left unattended and cannot be left with park staff. Anyone carrying a bag larger than 9"x11"x5" will not be admitted into the historic homes.

title: Be aware of floating debris on the Clear Creek Arm of Whiskeytown Lake.
description: With the reservoir being raised to full pool recently, there is a significant amount of wooden debris throughout the reservoir and most notably on the Clear Creek Arm west of Oak Bottom and below Judge Francis Carr Powerhouse. Plan like a park ranger for a safe day on the water. Click the link to learn more about water safety at Whiskeytown.

title: Summer Hours
description: Visitor Access to Fort Donelson NB Park Lands: Pedestrian access is from dawn to dusk. Automobile access to Fort Donelson NB Park Roads is from 8:00 am - 8:00 pm.

title: Temporary Museum Closure
description: The park museum in the visitor center is temporarily closed for the installation of new exhibits. All other areas within the visitor center such as the welcome desk, theater, and bookstore will remain open during the project.

title: New 2026 Summer Season Hours
description: Beginning May 23, 2026, Washington Headquarters Museum and the Jockey Hollow Visitor Center have new hours, as follows: Open Thursday - Monday, 9:30 am - 4:30 pm. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

title: Algoma Connecting Route Segment — Bridge Closed
description: On the suggested connecting route south of Algoma, the bridge over Three Mile Creek on Longfellow Road is closed to all travel, including pedestrians. Use 9th Road and STH‑42 to bypass this closure. The bridge on 10th Road is also closed. This 2.7‑mile alternate route replaces 2.8 miles of connecting route.

title: Indian Creek Segment — Machinery and Parking Closure
description: Recent logging near CTH-E (15th Street) may mean heavy machinery and log piles in the area. The parking lot on CTH-E remains closed on weekdays. Stay alert. Remain on the trail. Use caution. Keep dogs leashed.

title: Bacteria Levels at Arizona Hot Springs
description: Fecal bacteria in water samples taken from Arizona Hot Springs frequently reach high levels, which can transmit human diseases. To reduce health risks, the National Park Service recommends recreators limit body contact in these waters, clean after use, and to never put your head under water at hot springs. Please contact the Park at 702-293-8990 for updates on this advisory.

title: Stage 2 fire restrictions in effect
description: No setting, building, maintaining, attending, or using open fires of any kind in the park. This includes campfires and charcoal fires in Watchman Campground, South Campground, and picnic areas in Zion Canyon. Stoves fueled by petroleum or liquid propane gas are allowed. Smoking is allowed only in non-vegetated areas.

title: Katahdin Overlook Construction Closure
description: The Katahdin Overlook is currently closed for construction. Visitors are not permitted in the overlook area due to construction hazards. Construction is expected to be completed by mid-June 2026. All other locations on the Loop Road are accessible by motor vehicles seasonally and by foot year-round.

title: Navigation
description: Please do not rely upon GPS digital navigation systems to find your way to Craters of the Moon. Please note that the Robert Limbert Visitor Center at 1266 Craters Loop Road is located just off U.S. Highway 20/26/93 and is not accessed via any unpaved roads.

title: Stage 1 Fire Restrictions
description: Stage 1 fire restrictions in effect as of May 22, 2026. Use of portable gas stoves is permitted. Prohibited Actions: No open fires, No smoking outdoors within 3 feet of vegetation, No welding or similar devices, No flares, fireworks, etc.

title: Park Closed on Sunday, June 14
description: Steamtown National Historic Site will be closed to the public on Sunday, June 14 for safety and preparation needs preceding the visit of Union Pacific No. 4014. The site will reopen at 9 a.m. on Monday, June 15 and will be open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily through June 30 for the visit of No. 4014. All entries from June 15-30 require a timed reservation. See our Big Boy Reunion page for more information.

title: Timed Entry Reservations Required June 15-30, 2026
description: Due to the high visitation expected during the visit of Union Pacific Big Boy No. 4014, all entries to the park at from June 15 to June 30, 2026 will require a timed reservation through recreation.gov. There is a non-refundable service charge of $1 for each reservation. Please see our Big Boy Reunion page for more information.

title: Trail update 5/21/26
description: Most trails are open and ready for the public. Those that remain closed are the Charleston Road/ Goudey Trail past the Cherokee Path and the portion of Cherokee Path between the stockade fort and the Charleston Road.

title: Upcoming Power Outages in Bartlett Cove
description: Attention visitors, residents, and workers in Bartlett Cove and the Glacier Bay Park Headquarters area: Be aware of upcoming power outages related to local maintenance work. All lasting from approx. 9 am - 1 pm: Saturday, 5/23 - An outage will occur park-wide (all of Bartlett Cove local area). Sunday 5/24 - Outage at the park generator building, including the Bartlett Cove fuel dock. Monday 5/25 - Outage at the park maintenance building. Thursday, 5/28 - Outage at the Glacier Bay lodge.

title: Denali Park Road Information
description: In summer, the Denali Park Road is open to Mile 15 (Savage River) for personal vehicles. Vehicle travel further into the park is limited to transit and tour buses.

title: 2026 Tour Season
description: Visit https://www.nps.gov/adam/planyourvisit/2026-tour-season.htm for details on the 2026 tour season, including operating hours and tour offerings. The Visitor Center is open 9am-5pm Wednesdays-Sundays. The historic homes are open Wednesdays-Sundays. Entrance fees required for entry into historic homes. Guided tour reservations are available first-come, first-served on the day of the tour at the Visitor Center. Reservations not required for self-guided tours.

title: Stoplight In Use due to Limited Parking
description: Limited Parking at the Visitor Center is monitored by the use of a Stoplight. This light helps meter traffic so that parking spots are available for visitors. Stoplight generally in effect from 10 am to 4 pm. Wait times vary daily.

title: Stage 1 Fire Restrictions
description: Stage 1 Fire Restrictions begin May 21st. Igniting or using fires fueled by combustible materials, that create an open flame, is strictly prohibited. Smoking is only allowed within an enclosed vehicle or developed site. For details on fire restrictions, visit https://wildlandfire.az.gov/fire-restrictions

title: BE AWARE OF HIGH-WATER DANGER
description: Visitors should be aware of high-water danger. Heavy rain makes crossing flowing water hazardous for hikers and horseback riders.

title: Note About Using GPS for Directions
description: Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park is located at 72 McBride Avenue Extension, Paterson, NJ 07501. Use this full address when searching using a GPS device or map app or use GPS coordinates N40.91533° W74.17992°

title: What's Closed and What's Open on South Rim & North Rim
description: Visit this link for a list of the available visitor services in Grand Canyon Village, Desert View, and the North Rim.

title: Yaqui Ridge Trail Closure
description: Due to nearby construction and blasting, the 1-mile Yaqui Ridge Trail is closed starting April 13, 2026 until further notice to ensure visitor safety. The closure begins at the junction with Joe’s Canyon Trail, and access beyond this point is not permitted. This affects access to the southern terminus of the Arizona National Scenic Trail.

title: Sheep Hunting Closure
description: The Federal Subsistence Board closed sheep hunting to all users on Federal public lands within Yukon-Charley Rivers National Preserve and Glacier Mountain Controlled Use Areas Units in 20E and 25C due to significant declines to the sheep population. The authority was granted via WP26-76 on April 24, 2026 and the closure with extend through June 30, 2028.

title: Kīpukapuaulu Trail Temporary Closed Due to Hazardous Trees
description: Kīpukapuaulu Trail is temporarily closed due to hazardous trees. Park staff are assessing and will reopen the trail when it is safe.

title: Stage One Fire Restrictions currently in Place
description: Effective as of May 17th, 2026, Tonto National Monument will be under stage one fire restrictions. Building any fires with Charcoal or Wood, including Smoking is prohibited in all areas. Exceptions are propane and liquid petroleum stoves or lanterns.

title: Backcountry route open to vehicles May 15 - November 15
description: Valles Caldera's backcountry road system opens to vehicles on Friday, May 15, 2026. Forty vehicles passes will be issued per day through November 15, when the route closes for the 2026 season. Passes may be reserved up to 3 months in advance at Recreation.gov. Any remaining daily passes will be available on a first come, first served basis in the Volcano Discovery Center.

title: Janis-Ziegler House (Green Tree Tavern) Closed
description: The Janis-Ziegler House (Green Tree Tavern) building is currently closed, due to unsafe conditions. Other park buildings and grounds are open according to regular schedules. For program information, please check with park staff at the Ste. Genevieve Welcome Center, 573-880-7189.

title: Lower Monument Canyon Trail Work - Expect Short Delays through August 2026
description: Monday-Thursday and some Fridays, 7 am to 4:30 pm, mid-May through August, expect trail maintenance on lower Monument Canyon Trail. Work will take place on the lower 2.5 miles of the trail, from the lower trailhead up to the Wedding Canyon intersection at Independence Monument. No closures are currently scheduled, though hikers might experience short delays while traveling through work sites.

title: Bear Gulch Cave Closed
description: Due to maternal bat colonies present in Bear Gulch Cave, and in line with the expected seasonal closure scheduling, the Bear Gulch Caves are currently closed. The Balconies Cave remains open, and accessible from the Balconies or Old Pinnacles trails.

title: Elkmont/Sugarlands Dump Station is temporarily closed
description: The Elkmont/Sugarlands Dump Station is temporarily closed for maintenance. In the meantime, visitors can use the dump stations at Cosby, Cades Cove, or ones commercially available in Gatlinburg.

title: Government Wash Campground Seasonal Heat Closure May 15 – September 30
description: The Government Wash campground will close on May 15th to vehicle access and overnight camping to assess and manage area improvements and protect visitors and staff from extreme heat risks. The campground is anticipated to reopen for overnight stays on October 1st. It will remain open this summer to non-motorized vehicle access for daytime, non-camping related activities.

title: Seasonal Trail Closures Due to Extreme Heat May 15 – September 30
description: Goldstrike Canyon, Arizona Hot Springs, Liberty Bell Arch, White Rock Canyon, and Lone Palm trails will be closed for visitor and first responder safety. Please check the park website, social media, and weather for updates before visiting. Arizona, Goldstrike, and Lone Palm hot springs remain open and accessible by water.

title: Washington Blvd/Boundary Channel Dr Ramps Closed Nightly
description: Beginning Monday, May 18 and continuing until Friday, June 26, the ramps to and from Southbound Washington Blvd and Boundary Channel Dr will be closed Monday through Friday, from 6:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m. for construction work. Crews will be replacing damaged guardrails along the ramps.

title: Officer's Quarters #2 is Temporarily Closed for Maintenance
description: Officer's Quarters #2 and the top floor of the Dragoon Barracks is closed for rehabilitation. A virtual tour link is below.

title: Prescribed Burn on Monday, May 11
description: The prescribed burn for May 11 has concluded and the Circle Trail is now open to visitors.

title: Sturgeon Bay Segment — Partial Trail Closure
description: A 0.1‑mile section of the Ice Age Trail between South Neenah Avenue and West Yew Street is closed indefinitely. Use South Neenah Avenue and West Yew Street to bypass this section. This 0.5‑mile bypass replaces 0.5 miles of Ice Age Trail.

title: Accessible Parking Available
description: Accessible parking is available at the George Washington Carver Museum and The Oaks. For George Washington Carver Museum, after receiving your visitor pass, enter Tuskegee University through Lincoln Gates on Booker T. Washington Boulevard. Pass Margaret Murray Washington Hall and the Kellogg Hotel and Conference Center, then turn right to the parking garage. Accessible parking for The Oaks is at 1200 West Montgomery Road. For assistance, call Sheryl Buchanan at (334) 421-2153.

title: A.G Gaston Motel Closed for Construction
description: The 1954 wing of the A.G. Gaston Motel is closed for renovation. The construction is expected to take 18 months. When completed the site will increase accessibility with a new elevator so all visitors can access the second-floor, new exhibits to tell the story of the building and Project C, and revitalize this historic landmark. Follow the link for more information.

title: Voicemail Down
description: Voicemail is currently down at Longfellow House-Washington's Headquarters National Historic Site. While we work to fix this, please contact us via email for any inquiries or requests.

title: Delays along Highway 101
description: There are multiple traffic stops along Highway 101 from Orick, CA to Crescent City, CA due to road construction. Extra time may be needed to travel throughout the park. Delay times may vary. Please stay alert and drive cautiously.

title: Going-to-the-Sun Road Spring Status
description: Going-to-the-Sun Road is open to Avalanche Creek on the west side of the park. On the east side, the road is open to Jackson Glacier Overlook. Travel on open sections of the road may change due to spring weather conditions. Visitors should check road conditions before their arrival.

title: Manzanar Remains Open During US 395 Pavement Project
description: CalTrans begins a monthslong pavement project on US 395 adjacent to Manzanar National Historic Site on Monday, May 11, 2026. Crews will be working to ensure access to Manzanar remains open, but it will be important to travel cautiously as typical access may involve detours and map apps may be inaccurate. Though work is scheduled only during weekdays, lane closures and detours will be in place throughout the week. More information may be available through CalTrans.

title: Swallet Trail Temporarily Closed at Montezuma Well
description: The Swallet Spur Trail at Montezuma Well is temporarily closed to protect bats. All other trails on site including the 0.3 mile loop trail along the Well remain open and accessible. The trail at Montezuma Castle remains open.

title: Construction in the south end of the park
description: Construction projects underway. Moose-Wilson Road open between Granite Entrance and Rockefeller Preserve; closed between Rockefeller Preserve and Moose. Death Canyon Road and Trailhead closed. Taggart Trail detour in place.
relatedRoadEvents: [{'title': 'Moose-Wilson Road and Death Canyon Trailhead Construction', 'id': '3E0D0431-D76E-4D10-8290-DEAB7FA80B87', 'type': 'roadevent', 'url': 'https://www.nps.gov/grte/planyourvisit/conditions.htm'}]

title: Tyler Bend Pavilion Closure
description: Starting on January 20, 2026, the Tyler Bend Pavilion will be closed for construction on the pavilion restrooms. The Tyler Bend Pavilion parking area and Lower Launch River access remain open to the public. The Pavilion is expected to re-open no later than June 30, 2026.

title: Staircase, Adjacent Wilderness Areas Closed due to Bear Gulch Fire Impacts
description: Park crews have been removing hazard trees and repairing infrastructure. The Staircase developed area will reopen when multiple safety, infrastructure, and visitor services goals are met within Olympic National Park and Olympic National Forest. For a full list of closed trails and campsites, visit our Fire Conditions and Updates page.

title: Elevator Out of Service
description: The elevator at Thomas Edison's Laboratory Complex is out of service. The 2nd and 3rd floors of the Main Laboratory - Building 5 can still be accessed by staircases on either end of the building.

title: Fort Spokane Museum and Visitor Center to Close for Repairs
description: The Fort Spokane Museum and Visitor Center in Lake Roosevelt National Recreation Area is temporarily closed for the duration of the summer for critical historic preservation repairs. Dating to 1880, the landmark building originally served as the fort's guardhouse and now operates as the primary hub to introduce visitors to the park and its many resources.

title: Services Limited at Stehekin Landing
description: The park complex experienced severe weather events following flood damage in December 2025, causing unsafe conditions and limiting basic infrastructure in some areas. Operations at Stehekin Landing are limited.

title: Intermittent Road Closures During Utility Improvement Project
description: Beginning May 11, Stones River National Battlefield will implement intermittent road closures to support a utility improvement project by Middle Tennessee Electric. The park expects intermittent closures to continue for four months, depending on weather and construction conditions. Temporary closures and traffic impacts will occur in work areas along Thompson Lane and nearby sections of the battlefield. Visitors should expect intermittent disruptions and follow posted signs and staff directions.

title: Temporary Closure of Right Lane of Clara Barton Parkway
description: Temporary Closure of the Clara Barton Parkway Right Lane at Site 17, wooded areas between C&O Canal and Lock 10 parking lot, north to Lock 14, required to address ongoing safety concerns from DC Water emergency sanitary sewer overflow & bypass and pipe repair operations. Click on "More" below for specifica details on the closure.

title: Elevator for Accessible Tour Out of Service
description: Due to mechanical issues with the cave elevator, the Accessible Tour is currently unavailable. Please check back for updates or call the visitor center at (270) 758-2180.

title: Temporary Closure of Some Trails, Backcountry Campsites, and Fishing Areas
description: Certain trails, backcountry campsites, and fishing areas in the western part of the park near Biscuit Basin are closed until further notice to allow for an investigation following a bear-caused human injury.

title: Ridgelines and Summits May Still hold Ice and Snow.
description: Be aware and prepared that the ridgelines and summits may still hold a significant amount of snow and ice during the spring season and can be treacherous to navigate. You are responsible for your own safety. Speak with a ranger at the Great Basin Visitor Center or over the phone at 775-234-7331 for more information.

title: Partial Closures to Marquette Greenway Trail and Glenwood Dunes Trail
description: Marquette Greenway construction will require closing sections of the Glenwood Dunes Trail (April–December 2026) and Little Calumet / Mnoké Prairie Trail (May–December 2026). Closure dates may shift as work progresses. Please follow all posted closures and check the park website or NPS App for updates.

title: Isaac Potts House (Washington's Headquarters) Closed For Restoration
description: The Isaac Potts House (Washington's Headquarters at Valley Forge) is temporarily closed for a restoration project. The Washington's Headquarters area, including the Valley Forge Train Station and exhibits, Commander-In-Chief's Guard Huts, and George Washington statue, remains open and accessible during regular operating hours. Learn more about the restoration project at the link below.

title: Historic Andrew Johnson Homestead Reopens
description: The Home of our 17th president has reopened to the public. Daily tours available. See GUIDED TOURS information on website for more details.

title: Visitor Center Sidewalk Closed
description: The sidewalk around the Visitor Center is closed until further notice. Please do not go into the fenced off area for any reason. Visitors still need to park ONLY in designated areas. No parking is allowed along the road. The battlefield and fort are accessible from 9 AM - 5 PM through the Visitor Center. The grounds are still open sunrise to sunset and the site can be accessed after hours from the park road.

title: Temporary Closure of Park Areas for the UFC Freedom 250 Events
description: In conjunction with the event set up, orchestration, and eventual event tear down for the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) Freedom 250 activities and events, several areas within and surrounding President's Park will be closed to the public from approximately 12:00 a.m. on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, to approximately 11:59 p.m. on Sunday, June 28, 2026. For a closure map and more detailed information, please follow the link below.

title: Road to Juniper Lake Closed for Repairs
description: Road to Juniper Lake is closed to vehicle access due to needed repairs. Road leading to Juniper Lake sustained significant damage outside of the park with no ETA for repair.

title: Change in Hours for Summer Season
description: Due to the potential of excessive summer heat, starting Monday May 4, The Lower Cliff Dwelling Trail will close at 12:00P.M. The visitor center & park will remain open until 4:00P.M. These hours will be in place until Saturday October 3.

title: Road Construction Work to begin May 4-Oct 24, 2026
description: Road construction to occur Monday through Friday between the hours of 7:00 am and 8:00 pm, weather permitting. Expect delays of up to 30 minutes during active construction periods.

title: Road Construction Work to begin May 4-October 24
description: Road construction work to occur Monday thru Friday between the hours of 7:00 am and 8:00 pm, weather permitting. Expect delays of up to 30 minutes during active construction periods.

title: Temporary closure of some rock climbing routes to protect falcon nesting sites.
description: NORTHEAST FACE climbing routes, the NORTHEAST EDGES of the TOWER SUMMIT, and the NORTH FACE RAPPEL routes are CLOSED. Climbers should be aware of territorial aggression from nesting falcons. If falcons exhibit defensive or distressed behavior, descend off the Tower at the next safe opportunity and report the incident to a ranger or other park employee. Closure effective on May 1, 2026. Routes including and between Adrenaline Surfer and Dr. Zen are CLOSED.

title: Lees Ferry Campground Closure
description: The upper loop of the Lees Ferry Campground is closed through September 30th for renovations. Beginning June 1, 2026, the entire campground will be closed due to construction. Large equipment will be paving at the Lees Ferry campground. We estimate paving construction to last about three weeks, while upper loop construction will continue until September 30, 2026. Do not enter construction area. No other camping is available at Lees Ferry. There are campgrounds in Page AZ and Wahweap AZ.

title: The Preserve is Open, but K-177 Highway Closed 12 Miles North
description: Beginning Monday, March 2, K-177 will close for a bridge replacement near Council Grove on K-177; local traffic only. Tallgrass Prairie National Preserve is OPEN, but must be accessed from the south. K-177 thru traffic will be directed to follow the state detour on U.S. 56, U.S. 56/U.S. 77 and K-150. KDOT uses state highways for official detour routes for safety, weight and maintenance concerns. Go to KDOT website for detour map.

title: Open Season
description: Jumonville Glen, Mount Washington Tavern, and the Picnic Area are OPEN until October 31st. Jumonville Glen and the Picnic Area are open daily sunrise to sunset, and Mount Washington Tavern is open every day 10 am to 4 pm.

title: Saint-Gaudens NHP is cashless
description: Cash payments at Saint-Gaudens NHP are not accepted as a method of payment for entry passes. Credit and debit cards are accepted.

title: Snodgrass Hill Road Closure in Chickamauga Battlefield Begins Monday, May 4
description: Snodgrass Hill Road will be closed for construction within Chickamauga Battlefield beginning May 4. The project will provide routine road-paving maintenance to improve visitor safety and enhance the overall visitor experience. The park anticipates completing the project by mid-June 2026.   This project will affect the official Chickamauga Battlefield tour route by closing access to Tour Stop 8. A temporary stop will be designated for visitors. After Tour Stop 7, please follow the updated tour signage.

title: Construction Activity at Little Sand Bay; Boat and Kayak Access Maintained
description: Construction for the Little Sand Bay Marina Rehabilitation Project begins May 1. The Town of Russell boat launch and the NPS kayak beach will remain open, with short detours around work areas. Expect reduced parking, delays, and increased noise. The Little Sand Bay Visitor Center will be closed in 2026 due to construction.

title: Lodi Segment — Partial Trail Closure
description: The Ice Age Trail along Lodi Street between Main Street and Water Street is closed due to an infrastructure improvement project in downtown Lodi. The closure may last until July 1. When hiking eastbound, continue east on Sauk Street, turn left on Lodi Street, right on Hill Street, left on Mill Street, cross Water Street, and turn right to rejoin the Trail at the Pleasant Street bridge. Stay alert. Use caution. Keep dogs leashed.

title: Phone Messaging System Errors
description: Adams NHP's phone messaging system is currently experiencing issues resulting in incorrect messaging regarding tour availability and park hours. Please refer to the park website page for the 2026 Tour Season for the latest information to plan your visit

title: Reservations Only at Kyles Landing and Erbie - Starting September 1, 2026
description: Starting September 1, 2026, reservations will be required for all campsites at Kyles Landing and Erbie Campgrounds. Reservations must be made through Recreation.gov (www.recreation.gov) or by calling 877-444-6777. Reservations can be made the same day or up to six months in advance. Please note that cell phone service is unreliable in these areas, so it is strongly recommended to make your reservation before arriving at the campground.

title: Ongoing Closure Notices
description: Devils Island dock and campsites, West Bay Club on Sand Island, and the trail on Stockton Island between Presque Isle Bay and Quarry Bay are closed. These closures affect only a small portion of the Lakeshore. Enjoy your visit.

title: Closure of Piney Branch Parkway
description: From May 12 to June 8, Piney Branch Parkway will be closed for DC Water's work on the Piney Branch Tunnel Project.

title: Kennesaw Mountain Road Closed to Private Vehicles and Cyclists
description: Starting January 5th, 2026, the road to the top of Kennesaw Mountain will be closed to private vehicles and cyclists due to construction and painting. Shuttle service to the top of the mountain is ONLY available on weekends and select federal holidays. The park's Visitor Center is still accessible. This work is in preparation for the upcoming Safety Improvement Project. For updates, continue to check park's website.

title: Temporary Closures for Peregrine Nesting
description: The following established climbing management areas are closed to all public use from March 1, 2026 to July 15, 2026 to protect peregrine falcon nesting aeries: Newhalem Crag East and Newhalem Crag West (Ryan’s Wall).

title: China Beach Construction Phase 2 Spring - Summer 2026
description: Project continues with improvements to the lower terrace and picnic areas, rehabbing the interior and exterior of the bathhouse, and installing seating and foot wash station near beach. Projects are expected to take 16-18 months. See link for details.

title: Visitor Center and Bookstore Open Tues - Sun
description: Visitor Center and Bookstore hours are Tues - Sun 9-5. It is currently a .7 mile hike from the main parking lot and a .4 mile walk to the historic area from the Hikers Lot. Please keep this in mind. If you have access needs, please call the number posted in the parking lot.

title: El Calderon Trail closed for construction through July 2026
description: The El Calderon Trail and parking area are closed from August 11, 2025, through July 31, 2026, for a major improvement project. NPS Road 100 will remain open for local traffic only, and the Continental Divide Trail will remain open for CDT thru-hikers.

title: Lava Tube Bridge Replacement
description: Most of Nāhuku lava tube trail will remain open during bridge replacement but will only be accessible one way in and out from the east “exit” end. The rainforest trail to the front of the lava tube, the lava tube bridge and 50 feet into the cave will be closed during the replacement. The bridge replacement should be complete by the end of June. The restrooms will remain open.

title: Old Mine Road North Construction Closure Begins April 6, 2026
description: Old Mine Road between Jager Road and Route 206 will close to all traffic beginning on April 6, 2026. Contractors will work to rehabilitate a 3.5-mile stretch of road. The construction area will be closed to all traffic for the safety of park visitors and contractors.
